NinjaTrader Tradovate Connection Guide

Steps to Set Up a Tradovate NinjaTrader connection

Updated this week
1. Complete Account Activation

Ensure that you've completed the necessary steps to activate your BluSky account on our website.

2. Sign Into Tradovate to accept the Market Data Agreements:

Sign into trader.tradovate.com and fill out the profile, then accept the data agreements to activate the account.

3. Create a NinjaTrader Username (if you don't have one):

Go to NinjaTrader.com and sign up to create a username.

After creating your username, activate it through the confirmation email.

Download NinjaTrader

4. Configure your NinjaTrader Connection:

Open NinjaTrader and sign in with your NinjaTrader username.

If you don't see the configure button, enable "Multi-provider Mode" in Tools > Options > General > Multi-provider mode > Then restart NinjaTrader and sign back in.

Go to Control Center > Connections > configure.

Double-click "NinjaTrader" from the 'Available' list.

Enter your BluSky credentials and select "Simulation" at the bottom for account type.

Connect by selecting "NinjaTrader" from the Connections menu.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Troubleshooting: If you can connect, but don't see the account:

If you are able to connect to your BluSky credentials within NinjaTrader, but the evaluation account isn't showing, please write in to ClientServices@NinjaTrader.com with:

Your Email Address

NinjaTrader Username

Indicate BluSky.pro as the Evaluation Service
